items.title: I would not have voted for Zionism motion, Polanski says
items.summary: A motion declaring Zionism a form of racism was passed by Green Party members on Sunday.

items.title: Chris Mason: Questions remain for Green Party leader Zack Polanski
items.summary: Senior party figures have criticised his response to a motion passed by members declaring Zionism a form of racism.

items.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
items.summary: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

items.title: Emotions run high at the round table as Celebrity Traitors banish two players
items.summary: Viewers watched to see whether Richard E Grant could save himself at the first round table of the series.

items.title: £15m spent cleaning illegal waste supersite in ancient woodland
items.summary: Concerns remain over the ancient Kent woodland's future after 39,500 tonnes of rubbish were cleared.

items.title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force many in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
items.summary: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

items.title: Everton owners consider selling club two years after takeover
items.summary: Everton owners the Friedkin Group are exploring the sale of the club less than two years after taking control.

items.title: ​​USS Lincoln finally docks in San Diego after 10-month mission
items.summary: The US aircraft carrier was set to return in May but the war with Iran has kept it at sea on one of the longest deployments ever.
